sketch_notes: Both sketches depict a simple long-form article/blog post layout with static header text, a hero image, body copy, and footer/social links. There are no visible controls such as hamburger icons, menus, tabs, accordions, forms, search, modal triggers, sticky headers, load-more affordances, counters, or other widgets that would imply required JavaScript behavior. Any interactivity would likely be limited to standard link navigation handled natively rather than custom JavaScript.
